bones.tree: 31 bones, rooted at 0 (y -0.1). Spine chain 0->9 strictly up the y axis: y 4.0, 194.1, 405.9, 599.8, 813.5, 1018.2, 1168.9, 1318.1, 1463.4. At the spine top (bone 9) three branches: 10 (+z 38.8 = head/neck, child 28 at y 1639.4), 11 (-x 55.0, child 29 at y 1640.5), 12 (+x 55.0, child 30) = two claws. Four limb chains lower: 13->14->15 (-x to 443.4, from bone 8), 16->17->18 (-z to 609.3, from bone 7), 19->20->21 (+z to 469.1, from bone 8), 22->23->24 (+x to 529.7, from bone 7). Side spur 25->26 from bone 5.

head.note: top of the spine; siblings 11/12 are the two big blades held over the shoulders (their end nubs 28-30 reach y 163.9-164.0, x +-55, matching the mesh top 185.4 at that x)

chest.note: spine bone at y 116.9 where the fore/aft limb chains (16, 19) attach

bones.posture_note: the bind pose is already folded, not a clean T-pose: the mesh x/z extents are x -623..636, z -841..659 and the four limb chains (x +-520, z -609/+469) splay out from a central spine. In-game the Garrador crawls on these four limbs with the blade-arms raised; the bind pose reflects that hunched-forward stance, so a single humanoid shoulder/knee aim height does not exist for it.

Garrador.posture: four-limbed crawler (hunched): central spine 0->9 + two raised blade-arms (11/12) + four splayed limb chains (13-15, 16-18, 19-21, 22-24)
Garrador.posture_basis: bind pose (bone_world/bones local offsets), full 31-bone tree read; in-game idle is an FCV animation whose keyframes are not decoded

_meta.animation_slots: each em pack carries EFF/FCV/SEQ/BIN/TPL slots, no .anm/.mot. FCV IS the animation clip (header: frame count u16, node count u8, type u8, 2 bytes x node, then one bone id x node, then the keyframe payload). The FCV joint list is read here; its per-frame transform payload is NOT decoded, so in-game idle/crouch/attack poses are not recoverable from on-disk data without reverse-engineering FCV keyframes (out of scope for the aim-height question). SEQ slots are small tables (big-endian floats), not animation. Bind-pose-only posture is the ceiling for this ticket.
